parsed.name: PV位置控制组件
parsed.description: 用于通过过程变量接口执行位置设定与状态读写的非物理控制组件，可作为上层运动控制的抽象接口。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical control component that sets positions and reads/writes status through process-variable interfaces, acting as an abstraction for higher-level motion control.
